notes.title: V.1.4.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changelog V.1.4.2:

>Improved Flaggerong Face Animation in the Notebook
>Added School Temperature
>Added Secret Item in the Music Level
>Fixed Cleany catching Player delay (he will now Always catch you instantly with no delay)
>Added Secondary Building and School Gate in the Prologue
>Fixed bugs

notes.title: V.1.4.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:

>Added Game Prologue

>Improved Math Notebook

>Improved Other Level Notebooks

>Added Donut

>Added Sketch Map

>New Character: "Consuelor"

notes.content:

>Added Item Store (Now store is divided in two sections)

>Added 60 New Language Sentences

>Added Computer Science Achievement

>Added placeholder preview for the Next Bonus Level (National Flags)
